pricing.body: Pay for the build once, then a monthly fee. No contract, cancel whenever you want.

items.q: Does it work for my sport?
items.a: Yes. Karate, judo, football, dance, swimming and any club with groups, a schedule and monthly fees. We set up levels, groups and content for your sport.

items.q: Do you build sites outside sports?
items.a: Yes. We started with sports clubs, but we build websites, stores and systems for any business. See the Website, Online store and Custom system plans.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: No. We build and maintain everything. You tell us what needs to change.
The subscription stops renewing. The site and app keep working until the end of the month you already paid for.

items.q: Can I change the colors and photos?
items.a: Yes. Send us new photos or text and we put them up.

items.q: How do students pay their fees?
items.a: The coach records payments in their panel, and students see how far they are paid up in the app.
